# A cancellation request remains intent until the Asset confirms it

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll a Move To capable Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Scout One",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Scout One",
    "change_sequence": 1,
    "command_manifest": [
      {
        "cancellation": true,
        "command_id": "move_to",
        "progress": true,

          "queued"
        ]

      },

      },

        "value": "unknown"
      },
      "telemetry": {
        "latitude": 42.2743,
        "longitude": -71.8081
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<asset>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": "ground vehicle",
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

## 2. Prepare Move To

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

## 3. Issue a Task

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 2,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<Move To task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```

## 4. Request cancellation while the Asset is disconnected

```json
  "request_id": "<cancellation request>"
}
```

## 5. Late progress cannot clear cancellation intent

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<Move To task>/status` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<task report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "in_progress",
  "progress_percent": 25
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "cancellation_request_id": "<cancellation request>",
  "change_sequence": 5,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "execution_status": "in_progress",
  "id": "<Move To task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "progress_percent": 25,
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "cancellation_requested",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "version": 3
}
```

## 6. The assigned Asset confirms the identified cancellation

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<Move To task>/status` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<task report 2>",
  "sequence": 2,
  "status": "cancelled",
  "cancellation_request_id": "<cancellation request>"
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "cancellation_request_id": "<cancellation request>",
  "change_sequence": 7,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "execution_status": "in_progress",
  "id": "<Move To task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "progress_percent": 25,
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "version": 4
}
```

SDK `GET /tasks/<Move To task>` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "cancellation_request_id": "<cancellation request>",
  "change_sequence": 7,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "execution_status": "in_progress",
```

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<Move To task>/status` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<task report 3>",
```
